decisions.reason: Its visibility increased from a mention to its own page by 2024, and a multi-model safety shoe line sits squarely in the firm's core business.
The comfort insole has only limited website prominence and overlaps somewhat with the firm's stronger custom insole push, but it still supports the broader footwear system offer.
The supportive insole remains a relevant accessory for workers needing added foot support, even if it is less prominently positioned than the firm's flagship insole solution.
The ergonomic safety shoe series had its own page in both years and matches the firm's strategy of innovation, worker protection, and tailored performance.
Firefighter and rescue boots gained stronger presentation in 2024 and extend the firm's protective-footwear competence into a credible specialist segment.
As a homepage-highlighted flagship with explicit evidence of customer uptake in foot-measurement and individual insole supply, it is highly unlikely to be withdrawn.
